title: WPSS/1543/2004 of MOHAN SINGH MAHRA Vs STATE and ORS.

paras.text:
THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Writ Petition (S/S) No. 1543 of 2004.
Mohan Singh Mahra S/O Sri Kunwar Singh Mahra (since deceased)
substituted by 1/1 Smt. Heera Devi and others.
... Petitioners.
Vs.
State of Uttaranchal and others.
...Respondents.
Mr. C.D.Bahuguna, Advocate, learned counsel for the petitioners.
Mr. Subhash Upadhyay, Brief Holder, learned counsel for the respondents.
Date September 10, 2010.
Hon'ble B.S.Verma, J.
(Misc. Application No. 7690 of 2010)
 Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the
record.
 This Miscellaneous Application No. 7690 of 2010 has
been moved on behalf of the petitioners with the prayer that the writ
petition may be decided in the same terms, as has been decided in Writ
Petition of Daulat Ram Sharma (Writ Petition No. 2134 of 2001(S/S)
Daulat Ram Sharma Vs. State of Uttaranchal and others, decided by
order dated 24-6-2004).
 By means of this writ petition, the petitioner-Mohan
Singh Mahra (since deceased) has sought a writ in the nature of
mandamus commanding the respondents to grant L.T. grade to the
petitioner w.e.f. the date of provincialisation and upgradation of the
institution with all consequential benefits of service i.e. 1-8-1978.
 It appears that one Daulat Ram Sharma filed Writ
Petition No. 2134 of 2001 (S/S) before this Court praying for writ of
mandamus and claiming L.T. grade from the date of upgradation and
provincialisation of the school from 8-7-1976. This writ petition was
allowed by order dated 24-6-2004 passed by this Court.
 Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that this writ
petition was earlier allowed in terms of the order dated 24-6-2004
passed by this Court in W.P.S.S. No. 2134 of 2001, Daulat Ram

2
Sharma Vs. State of Uttaranchal and others by order dated25-8-2005.
Subsequently, modification application No. 6731 of 2005 was moved
before this Court for clarification of the date of provincialisation and
upgradation of the institution of the petitioner. The modification
application was disposed of by order dated 6-9-2005 and it was
directed that the petitioner Mohan Singh Mahra shall be treated in LT
grade w.e.f. 1-8-1978 and arrears of salary to the petitioner shall be
paid to him with effect from 01-08-1978.
 Subsequent to that, the respondents-State filed a recall
application (No. 12461 of 2006) on the ground that the order passed in
WPSS No. 2134 of 2001 Daulat Ram Sharma Vs. State of Uttaranchal
and others, on the basis of which this writ petition bearing WPSS No.
1543 of 2004 had been allowed, has been stayed by a Division Bench
of this Court on 26-9-2006 passed in Special Appeal No. 72-D of 2006
(Special Appeal No. 122 of 2006), which has been preferred by the
State, therefore, the orders dated 25-8-2005 and 6-9-2005 be recalled.
The recall application was allowed and the orders were recalled by
order 8-12-2006.
 Thereafter, by order dated 3-12-2009 passed by the
Division Bench, the special appeal No. 122 of 2006 was finally
dismissed. The copy of order has been annexed by the petitioners as
Annexure-1 to the Miscellaneous Application No. 7690 of 2010. A
perusal of the order dated 3-12-2009 reveals that the order passed in
WPSS No. 2134 of 2001 was affirmed.
 Accordingly, in view of the judgment dated 3-12-2009
passed in Special Appeal No. 122 of 2006 State of Uttarakhand and
others Vs. Daulat Ram Sharma, the order dated 25-8-2005 as modified
by order dated 6-9-2005 passed in the writ petition is maintained and
the writ petition is allowed accordingly. Miscellaneous Application
No. 7690 of 2010 stands disposed of.
